title: Traffic replication safeguards and quarantine controller for mirrored requests
creator: Asha Patel
description: Add a traffic-replication safety layer and a quarantine controller to Redwood's mirroring pipeline so that mirrored (shadow) requests can be duplicated with tenant-aware sampling and automatic isolation when cost or error patterns are suspicious. This ticket covers the controller, policy DSL, and runtime hooks required to safely expand mirrored traffic for model evaluations and canary experiments.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Mirrored path supports per-tenant budget caps and soft / hard thresholds; 2) Sampling strategies: deterministic prefix sampling, rate-based sampling, and user-specified sampling sets; 3) Quarantine controller will automatically pause/route-to-quarantine a tenant's mirrored stream on anomalies (error spike, throughput surge, sudden cost acceleration); 4) Service-level SLOs: mirrored duplication must not increase primary path p95 latency by >5ms under typical load; 5) Metrics and dashboards for shadow cost, mirror QPS, quarantine events, and sampled error deltas; 6) E2E tests and chaos test demonstrating safe fallback and resume behavior.
implementation_plan: Design a light-weight policy DSL for replication: budget_limit, sample_rate, sampling_mode, quarantine_rules
Add replication middleware in the gateway to attach trace headers and sample decisions deterministically for idempotence
Implement a Quarantine Controller service that subscribes to mirror telemetry, evaluates policies, and emits tenant-specific actions (pause, throttle, routed_quarantine) via the control plane
Integrate with existing billing estimator to compute projected mirror spend and trigger soft warnings vs hard stops
Expose per-tenant mirror controls in the Console (read-only for now) and hook for programmatic overrides via API
Build E2E test harness using synthetic tenants to validate sampling, quarantine, and recovery flows
Ship small canary to 5% of tenants for 2 weeks before broad enablement
decisions: Use deterministic hashing of request id + tenant id to allow reproducible sampling across retries and replay
Quarantine actions will be tenant-scoped only; we will not remove mirrored requests globally except in critical incidents
Controller will operate with eventual consistency; mirror decision latencies up to 1s acceptable (controller sends control deltas)
tradeoffs_and_notes: Quarantine logic favors safety over coverage: aggressive quarantine reduces mirrored coverage and slows model evaluation velocity. We prioritize tenant isolation and cost containment over maximizing mirror volume. Deterministic sampling by default may under-sample low-volume tenants; we will add targeted sampling sets for small tenants used in experiments.
risks: Mistuned sampling or too-lax budgets may drive unexpectedly high cloud GPU spend
Controller flaps (oscillation between pause/resume) if thresholds are too narrow
Extra metadata propagation could increase request header sizes and affect downstream proxies
tests: Unit tests for sampling logic (deterministic and rate modes)
Integration test: gateway + controller with simulated telemetry (inject error spikes)
Chaos test: controller datastore partition + recovery to ensure idempotent resume
Load test: ensure mirrored duplication doesn't increase primary p95 by >5ms at 80th percentile traffic

runbook_snippet: On quarantine event: 1) Controller emits event to ops channel; 2) Ops checks projected cost and recent error diffs; 3) If false positive, allow manual override and increase cool-down period; 4) For real incidents, keep quarantine and notify tenant contacts.
